comment: Independent trap.c sink_into_lava() witness, unmounted. A fire-resistant Valkyrie wishes for lava under herself, so lava_effects() traps her (TT_LAVA), then searches in place: each turn allmain.c moveloop_core() calls sink_into_lava(), which lowers u.utrap's high byte and, since she did not move, adds rnd(4). When the high byte runs out she sinks below the surface and dies (done(DISSOLVED)); answering the debug-mode 'Die?' prompt with the default 'n' takes the life-saved arm: reset_utrap(TRUE), then safe_teleds(). Searches typed after death land on --More-- and are ignored.
